passed_rows.block_text: PETS Accordion Item Are pets allowed at Daxton? The Daxton Hotel welcomes all service animals trained to assist their owners during their time at the hotel. Daxton complies with all ADA regulations regarding service animals and Daxton associates are happy to assist our guests with service animals in any way. Per ADA guidance, Daxton's operations policy and Michigan Public Health Code, Daxton associates will inquire as to the animal's status and their specific training. No animals of any kind, other than identified and confirmed service animals, are allowed in the public spaces of the hotel, per the Michigan Modified Food Code. Unfortunately, "emotional support" animals are not considered service animals. Only dogs are permitted and they must be 50 lbs. or less. The max number of dogs a guest may have per room is two (2). Daxton Hotel reserves the right to modify its policies at any time.
